description: This file defines utility functions and constants for font management and color generation within the vtiger CRM project, including font name calculation based on locale, color array generation, and axis tick spacing calculations.

methods.name: calculate_font_name
methods.description: Returns the font name based on the provided locale, with special handling for Chinese language codes.

methods.name: color_generator
methods.description: Generates an array of color hex strings based on starting color, step increments, and count.

methods.name: get_tickspacing
methods.description: Calculates appropriate major and minor tick spacing for chart axes based on the maximum axis value.
